_comment: Canonical header/footer for warrenlabs.com. Read by nav.js (Astro) and by tools/gen_site.py in the monorepo (the /plugins pages). Edit here only.
_analyticsComment: Plausible, added 2026-08-24 ahead of CanJam. Cookieless, so no consent banner and nothing to opt into; disclosed in /privacy. There is NO account id in the snippet -- Plausible keys on data-domain -- so this works the moment warrenlabs.com is added at plausible.io and harmlessly 404s until then. The .file-downloads.outbound-links variant auto-tracks GitHub release downloads, App Store links and mailto: clicks, which is most of what we want to know without hand-instrumenting anything. Read by all THREE renderers: Layout.astro, tools/sync-chrome.mjs, and tools/gen_site.py in the monorepo. Set enabled=false to pull it from all three at once.
